task_completion.description: Fetch PDB 2OMF from the RCSB and display it in PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '2OMF' and a protein structure (trimer) is visible in the viewer.

task_completion.description: Isolate a single monomer (e.g., chain A) from the trimer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The viewer shows only one of the three porin units (a single beta-barrel) instead of the full trimer.

task_completion.description: Color basic residues (Lys16, Arg42, Arg82, Arg132) blue and acidic residues (Asp113, Glu117) red.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the pore view, specific residues on opposite sides of the internal channel are colored blue and red, representing the transverse electric field.

task_completion.description: Measure the distance between the alpha-carbons (CA) of Arg82 and Asp113.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or label is visible in the PyMOL viewer connecting Arg82 and Asp113, showing a value (approximately 16-17 Angstroms).

task_completion.description: Save a high-quality cross-section PNG to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command log shows a 'png' command or 'export' dialog targeting '~/PyMOL_Data/images/ompf_constriction_zone.png'.

task_completion.description: Write a structural analysis report with the fold type, residue list, and distance.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows a file 'ompf_pore_report.txt' containing the words 'beta-barrel', the specific residue names, and the measured distance.

integrity.description: The agent used the PyMOL GUI or command line interface within the application rather than just creating a file via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL application window, mouse selections, or commands being typed into the PyMOL internal console.

integrity.description: The distance measurement was actually performed in the software, not hallucinated.
integrity.visual_evidence: The PyMOL viewer displays a 'dist' object or a dashed line between the two specified residues with a numerical label.

integrity.description: The agent saved files to the specific paths requested in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal or file explorer screenshots show the existence of 'ompf_constriction_zone.png' and 'ompf_pore_report.txt' in the ~/PyMOL_Data/ directory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 2OMF. The protein is a beta-barrel porin. The specific residues to be colored blue are Lys16, Arg42, Arg82, and Arg132. The residues to be colored red are Asp113 and Glu117 (located on the L3 loop). The expected distance between the CA atoms of Arg82 and Asp113 is approximately 16.3 Angstroms (accept values between 15-18A). The output image must be at ~/PyMOL_Data/images/ompf_constriction_zone.png and the report at ~/PyMOL_Data/ompf_pore_report.txt.
